title_contract.plot_fidelity_for_marketing_payoff: minimum relationship or conflict connection only; B need not be a literal plot event or ending
title_contract.public_payoff_anchor_contract: one concrete Chinese internal position-change note that directly answers A; evaluated independently of the optional Chinese review translation
title_contract.review_translation_contract: Chinese review aid only; its presence, punctuation, format, wording, semantic keyword choice, and similarity never determine production acceptance, retry, child safety, theme alignment, or creative collision
title_contract.cold_viewer_contract: replace bare story-internal proper nouns with a universally understandable description of the current relationship, event, or position change

generation_strategy.core_definition: A concrete perceptible event creates immediate emotional debt; B directly repays that debt through a clear position change
thinking_order: whether the event directly changes the position between people regardless of event type
generation_strategy.event_priority: prioritize events that directly change the position between people; event type itself does not determine priority
generation_strategy.position_change_signals: selection, exclusion, recognition, replacement, protection, or a change in status between people
generation_strategy.procedural_fact_priority: high only when the procedural fact carries such a position change
generation_strategy.amplifier_grounding: must be supported by current task evidence, channel-permitted marketing extrapolation, or the frozen contract; never invent identity, amount, assets, power, or relationships merely for intensity
model_only_self_check: A creates immediate emotion for a cold viewer
A contains a concrete perceptible event
B directly repays the emotional debt created by A
A-to-B remains understandable without full plot context
the title contains one main emotional causal line
generation_strategy.self_check_usage: candidate generation ranking and internal rewrite only

stage_order: finalize marketing semantics and the A-to-B causal line
realize them naturally in the target language
target_language_realization.purpose: reduce first-read comprehension cost while making the unchanged marketing meaning clear, natural, concise, and locally idiomatic for the current channel language and market; do not pursue literary completeness
allowed_expression_adjustments: pronoun use or omission of an obvious subject
locally natural number amount and identity expression
accepted loanword use according to current channel context
must_not: invent identities amounts assets power or relationships
turn the title into a synopsis
expand the title with background or narrative detail
model_only_native_language_self_check: a local cold viewer immediately understands who did what to whom
the expression does not preserve unnatural Chinese source order
the wording is not merely grammatical but locally natural
the title is as short and smooth as possible without weakening its marketing force
the relationship, action, and result remain immediately clear

title_contract.minor_title_hard_gate: forbid humiliation, bullying, abuse, sexualization, and age-inappropriate conduct only when the affected person is actually a minor; explicitly adult offspring are adults
title_contract.child_visual_reframing: keep the public A+B title explosive; in visual_thesis, child_role, and safe_cover_scene move visible wrongdoing and confrontation onto adults and keep required minors calm, protected, supervised relationship or identity anchors
